slot_scores.name: project1_investment_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can you invest in project (1) at the beginning of each of the three years
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked whether project (1) can be invested in at the beginning of all three years, covering the flexible multi-year timing.

slot_scores.name: project1_reinvestment_rule
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For project (1), is the 20% annual profit paid at the end of each year while the original investment amount remains available for reinvestment, or is the 20% profit the only return and the principal is not recovered
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether project (1) principal and profit are available for reinvestment in the following year.

slot_scores.name: project2_recovery_timing
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked when project (2) funds are recovered. Its Turn 2 question focused on the total return amount and assumed receipt at the end of Year 3, rather than checking the hidden end-of-Year-2 recovery timing.

slot_scores.name: project3_investment_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can investments in projects (3) and (4) be made at the beginning of any of the three years, or are they restricted to specific years
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about project (3)'s investment timing and the user clarified it is restricted to the beginning of the second year.

slot_scores.name: project4_investment_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can investments in projects (3) and (4) be made at the beginning of any of the three years, or are they restricted to specific years
slot_scores.rationale: The same question explicitly included project (4), and the user clarified that project (4) is restricted to the beginning of the third year.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Project (2) funds are received/recovered at the end of Year 3 rather than at the end of Year 2.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked for project (2)'s recovery date; its Turn 2 question assumed end-of-Year-3 receipt, and the READY_TO_MODEL summary treats that timing as confirmed.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved H1, H2, H4, and H5, but stopped at READY_TO_MODEL with the P1 slot H3 unresolved after silently assuming project (2) is recovered at the end of Year 3.

summary: The agent recovered most hidden timing and reinvestment facts through direct questions, but it missed project (2)'s recovery timing and silently assumed end-of-Year-3 recovery, leading to a premature stop with a P1 slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
